subject: Dynamic list-price floor and distributor uplift - bundle packaging
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <procurement@veridianhealth.com>
Cc: Ellie Ramos <ellie.ramos@veridianhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Dynamic list-price floor and distributor uplift - bundle packaging

Hi Samir / Ellie,

Thanks again for taking the call yesterday. As discussed, we can offer a private offer on Azure Marketplace that bundles our inference runtime + managed instance support into a single SKU for Veridian Health. Two items you flagged in procurement that I wanted to put in writing so we can move quickly:

- List-price floor: we propose a dynamic floor tied to committed volume. This lets us protect partner visibility in the marketplace while permitting downstream resale.
- Distributor uplift: we can accommodate a distributor uplift pass-through (one-time uplift on activation) — want to confirm whether Veridian expects this to be shown on the marketplace invoice or as a separate distributor invoice.

Attached is a simple SKU sheet with the proposed bundle mapping and an initial list-price anchor. I left placeholders for the uplift percent so we can align on channel economics.

Next steps I propose:
1) You confirm whether distributor uplift should appear on the marketplace invoice or external distributor invoice.
2) We agree target uplift % (we typically see 10–20% for distributor uplifts on bundles).
3) We send a short redline for signatures.

Happy to hop on a quick call this week if helpful.

Thanks,
Dylan Brooks
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
D: +1 415-555-0198
attachments: sku_sheet.csv (csv)

From: Samir Patel <procurement@veridianhealth.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ellie Ramos <ellie.ramos@veridianhealth.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Jun 2027 11:14:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Dynamic list-price floor and distributor uplift - bundle packaging

Dylan — thanks for the note and the SKU sheet. A few clarifying questions from procurement before we can route to our legal and billing teams: 

- On the list-price floor: we need a short definition we can include in the PO that explains how the floor moves as committed volume is realized. Is it a timebound floor (e.g., 12 months) or tied to cumulative consumption?
- Distributor uplift: Veridian prefers uplift to be visible on the marketplace invoice (one line item) so downstream auditors can reconcile. Is that supported by your marketplace integration?
- Channel margin: our reseller partners will expect visibility into the distributor pass-through so they can compute downstream margins. Can you provide a sample margin waterfall showing list price -> uplift -> partner commission -> net revenue to Redwood?

I've attached a short redline we prepared with our procurement comments (redline_contract_v1.pdf). Once you return the economic table and a PO-friendly definition of the list-price floor, we'll escalate to legal.

Appreciate it — Samir
Samir Patel
Head of Procurement, Veridian Health
procurement@veridianhealth.com
attachments: redline_contract_v1.pdf (pdf)

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 16 Jun 2027 13:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Dynamic list-price floor and distributor uplift - bundle packaging

Folks — looping you in. Veridian asked for three deliverables: PO-friendly definition of the list-price floor, confirmation that distributor uplift can be shown on the marketplace invoice, and a sample margin waterfall. Can we turn around a proposed economic table and legal-friendly floor language by EOD tomorrow?

My suggested defaults (need ops/legal sign-off):
- Distributor uplift: 15% uplift at activation (one-time), shown as a line item on the marketplace invoice.
- Reseller commission: allow reseller/partner commission of 7% on net list price after uplift (so partners can resell).
- List-price floor behavior: timebound floor tied to first 12 months from activation; floor = negotiated list price less X% if cumulative usage falls below threshold Y. (Need exact formula below.)

If that sounds reasonable, can someone:
- Ben: produce a simple margin waterfall (CSV) that shows list price -> uplift -> reseller commission -> net to Redwood for sample volumes (monthly usage: 50k, 200k, 800k tokens).
- Irene: propose a PO-friendly sentence for the "list-price floor" clause (one short paragraph).
- Soojin: confirm marketplace invoice support for uplift line item on Azure and GCP private offers and any ops caveats.

I'll combine and send back to Samir.

Dylan

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <procurement@veridianhealth.com>
Cc: Ellie Ramos <ellie.ramos@veridianhealth.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 17 Jun 2027 15:34:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Dynamic list-price floor and distributor uplift - bundle packaging

Samir — thanks for the redline. We're aligned on how to present this and have prepared the artifacts you requested. Summary below and attachments included.

Quick answers:
- List-price floor (PO language): "List-Price Floor" means the customer-specific minimum list price for the Bundled SKU(s) for a period of twelve (12) months from Activation. The Floor is calculated as the Negotiated List Price less a sliding adjustment if cumulative usage over the first 12 months is below the threshold set forth in the Purchase Order. The exact threshold and sliding adjustment percentage will be set forth in the PO line items.

- Distributor uplift: We will include a separate line on the Marketplace invoice titled "Distributor Uplift" showing the agreed uplift percentage applied at activation. Archival copies and invoice metadata will be retained for audit for 36 months.

- Sample margin waterfall: attached file partner_margin_workup.xlsx shows the waterfall for three usage tiers. Example (monthly):
  * List price (bundle): $100,000
  * Distributor uplift (15%): $15,000
  * Subtotal: $115,000
  * Reseller commission (7% on subtotal): $8,050
  * Net to Redwood: $106,950

Attachments: sku_sheet_v2.csv (updated SKU mapping with PO fields), partner_margin_workup.xlsx (margin waterfall workbook).

Next steps:
1) Please confirm the uplift percentage (we used 15% in the workbook) and the threshold bands for the list-price floor adjustment.
2) If the redline is acceptable, can we get procurement to approve so our legal teams can finalize? We can also attach the PO-friendly language into the DocuSign package (link below) for signature.

DocuSign: https://docusign.com/VER-5734-PO
Redwood deal page: https://app.redwood.ai/deals/VER-5734

If you'd like, I'm available for a 20-minute call Friday to walk through the waterfall.

Best,
Dylan Brooks
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
attachments: sku_sheet_v2.csv, partner_margin_workup.xlsx
